teachers.role: direct-raster multitask teacher for wall/room/icon segmentation and junction heatmaps
teachers.notes: Directly matches the application's raster input domain and provides windows/doors plus junction supervision. Because CubiCasa5K is CC-BY-NC-4.0, this teacher is development-time only for the current personal/non-commercial project and is never bundled in the public APK.

Allowed only as a personal/non-commercial development-time teacher. It is never bundled in the APK. If project use becomes commercial, exclude it or retrain equivalent wall supervision from commercially compatible data.

teachers.role: polygon/topology architecture reference and optional raster-adapted teacher
teachers.notes: Upstream pretrained models target top-down density maps from 3D scans, not arbitrary raster drawings. Do not treat an off-the-shelf checkpoint as direct raster evidence. Use only after an explicit raster adaptation/retraining step with compatible data.

teachers.role: continuity-aware edge/topology architecture reference and optional raster-adapted teacher
teachers.notes: Upstream license adds a Commons Clause and requires a separate commercial license for paid/commercial use. Upstream input is not the same as a raster floorplan screenshot, so no off-the-shelf CAGE output is accepted as direct evidence. It may be used only as a personal/non-commercial development-time teacher after explicit raster adaptation.

teachers.role: high-resolution boundary refiner around already measured geometry
teachers.notes: Use the verified universal ONNX export and retain license/attribution with packaged assets. It cannot create topology on its own.
